title: Resilient Logistics under Burst Disruptions: generator, dominance filter, and recorded result manifests
description:
Code, brute-force checks and recorded results for the manuscript Outage scenarios that suffice for two-stage and multi-stage robust capacity design: the scenario sets written down and counted (src/ol_scenarios.py), every experiment (src/run_ol_final.py), the recorded results (results/34_scenario_counts to results/43_trees_one_session_k3), and the checks of the statements together with the script that regenerates every number of the manuscript (checks/optimization_letters/).

The repository also keeps the material of version 1: scenario generator, dominance preprocessing, solver drivers, unit tests and recorded result manifests of an earlier manuscript on the same cislunar instance.
